newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash soybeans slip after Chicago.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash soybeans slip after Chicago.

text.p: Argentine cash soybeans slid to close lower after Chicago in slow trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange Thursday, traders said.

FAS elevator soybeans lost $8 to $262 for delivery to the port of Rosario, with few sellers around to accept the low prices being bid. Cash sunflower seed slipped $2 to $218 in sympathy with soybeans for Rosario, also in light turnover. FAS elevator Maize shed $1 for Buenos Aires to $103, on ebbing export demand.
